authn.name: X-Step-Id
authn.description: A sign-in step's id (#1454), kept out of every address: a page sends `-` in place of the id in a `/mfa/`, `/pending/`, `/password-change/` or `/consent/` path and the id here. Read only on those paths.

authn.name: X-Step-Query
authn.description: The `authn`, `mfa` and `enrol` query values a page took off the address (#1454), as a query string. Read as if they were in the query.
